tool.name: vsearch_dereplicate
tool.description: Merge strictly identical sequences contained in filename. Identical sequences are defined as having the same length and the same string of nucleotides (case insensitive, T and U are considered the same).

param.name: threads
param.label: Number of Threads
param.help: Number of CPU threads to use

tool.help:
**vsearch_dereplicate**
Merge strictly identical sequences contained in filename. Identical sequences are defined as having the same length and the same string of nucleotides (case insensitive, T and U are considered the same).
**nf-core Module Information:**
- Module: vsearch/dereplicate - Container: biocontainers/vsearch:2.28.1--h6a68c12_1
**Usage:** This tool provides the functionality from the nf-core module within Galaxy workflows.
